verdict.rationale: Extend documents async processing, credit-based billing, and support for 2,000+ page documents, suggesting some capacity for large-scale batch work, but no evidence names concrete rate limits, requests-per-minute caps, or throughput/SLA guarantees for millions-of-pages workloads. Missing for 10: documented API rate limits (req/sec or page/min caps), enterprise throughput SLAs, and any case study or benchmark showing millions-of-pages batch runs.
